reason: The outer-before guard is aria-hidden with tabindex 0, but it is a focus guard: in a focusin log, Tab and Shift+Tab pass through it to the next real control (Amount, or the Keyword button) in one keypress and focus never rests on it. The ax probe shows it ignored, so no phantom stop exists.
criterionAnalysis: 4.1.2 covers UI components a user operates; this node is a 1px clipped focus guard that hands focus to the next real control in the same keypress, and the ax probe shows it ignored in the accessibility tree, so no name or role is owed. 2.4.3 holds: Tab from the last control in the menu goes to Amount and Shift+Tab from the search box goes to the Keyword button, with no extra stop. 2.4.7 does not fail because focus never rests on the guard. 2.1.2 does not fail because focus leaves the menu with one keypress each way.
